tei:div.tei:p: (ta)༄༅// rang gi rtogs brjod thang kar bkod pa'i zhal byang don bsdu kun dga' bskyed pa'i zhing khams rgya mtsho zhes bya ba bzhugs so// theg gsum bstan pa smra mkhas ded dpon bsten// tshulaṃ khrimasaṃ bslab pa'i rinaṃ cheṃn gling mchog son// phyi nang gtsug lag nor bu 'dod 'jo yis// rang gzhan 'dod pa'i re skong de la 'dud// bod yul 'bri klung gser dang ldan ma'i 'gram// shis pa'i mtshan bkra sa dkar bsam gling du// zhang rigs ngag chos bu chog thabs shes sras// sha na'i gos bcas me glang skyes la 'dud// 'phags yul 'jam dpal grags dang zhi ba 'tsho// rat+na'i ming can dag dang yang mes po// bla ma sangs rgyas lha dbang sgyu 'phrul gar// nges par lung bstan 'phrin snyan shod la 'dud// rta mgrin srung btags 'dri klog chos 'chad sogs// sngon goms shugs bzang nam mkha' 'od gsal las// dbang nod skabs shig rmi lam gter rnyed dang*// nam mkha'i nor bu lag rtser son la 'dud// gzhon nu'i 'jug sgo yig klog bslab pa dang*// lats+tsha na sogs rgya bod yig rigs shes// bar snang chu 'dzin 'khrigs khrod ber nag can// gdong brnyan 'khor bcas mjal bar mthong la 'dud// drung pa kun dga' rgya mtshor gtsug phud phul// dge bsnyen sgrub ming kun dga' bsod nams stsal// nam mkhar 'ja' ris gsar pa'i rgyal mtshan gdugs// bkra shis rtags kyi dge mtshan mthong la 'dud// rang gi khang steng phyin pas nam mkha' la// yi ge'i gzugs shar de las du ma 'phel// shar phyogs nam mkhar sprin dkar shing rtar brten// ston pa dgra bcom bcas 'byon rmis la 'dud// dbang blas bde mchog sta gon tshugs pa'i nub// gyang logs de na 'khor lo bde mchog sku// zhal phyag rgyan rdzogs mthong ba'i rmi lam bzang*// gzhan yang zab chos mang du thos la 'dud// shug ra he ru ka las kye rdo rje// kun rig mi 'khrugs dbang chos dpag med mnos// rmi lam ltad mo nam mkha' dwangs pa'i ngos// karma mi bskyod pa nyid mjal la 'dud// thu ma'i gzhung 'grel gyis mtshon brda dag rigs// bde dus dgra nag gis bstan sku gzugs dang*// dkyil 'khor rigs kyi cha tshad skar nag rtsis// gso rig gzhung sogs legs par rtogs la 'dud// mkhas mchog 'chi med drung phyin brda sprod gzhung*// rang bzhin rkyen dang rnam gyur ston pa dang*// bṛ ta dzā ti'i sdeb sbyor snyan ngag gi

/rgyan gsum legs bshad 'doms pa'i mchog la 'dud// sna tshogs 'gro ba'i blo dang 'tsham pa'i chos// ci 'dod 'jo ba'i 'byung gnas dpal sa skya// e waṃ chos ldan la phyin skyabs mgon rnams// zhal mjal byin rlabs skal ba bzang la 'dud// ngor du mkhan chen tshul khrims lhun grub las// tshigs gsum rim mnos dge slong dngos por bsgrubs// mdo sngags lam chen gsung ngag rin po che'i// dbang khrid kyis mtshon mang thos gyur la 'dud// mngon sum rjes dpag ston pa tshad ma dang*// nang rig sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi'i// nges par bstan pa lta bsgom spyod pa'i gzhung*// phal cher thos dang sbyangs mthar son la 'dud// ngor gyi chos smra kun las chos mang thos// rmor chen rje las dbang khrid rjes gnang rigs// thos pa'i rna lung yangs byas lha ldan du// jo shag zhal mjal dge tshogs bsags la 'dud// khams su bder phyin kye rdor gur mgon gyi// bsnyen sogs dag byas sangs rgyas dpal bzang las// bde dgyes gsang gsum ngan song sbyong dkyil sogs// dbang khrid gdams pa'i bka' drin nos la 'dud// mgon der snyan dngags sdeb sbyor lam 'bras rlung*// 'khrul 'khor bcas phul de dbon tshul dbang par// sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i rjes gnang rgya bod gzhung*// lung dang rjes gnang kha shas stsal la 'dud// mkhan chen bkras lhun zhabs dang sangs rgyas bstan// bkras bzang nam bzang dag las bde dgyes sogs// dbang bskur gdams pa mang thos de skabs shig /dbyangs can dgyes pa'i 'dzum zhal mthong la 'dud// chos rgyal yab sras bka' bzhin gong ma lnga'i// gsung rab dgongs 'grel la sogs par 'dri zhus// dgos stsal gegs sel bstan srung phrin bcol dang*// las byed gsang bdag dbang gis bsrungs la 'dud// par khang ldebs bris gtso bo 'dri ba dang*// dpal chos gtsor bzhugs rab gnas mdzad pa'i tshe// bzang drug rgyas bshad rten dang brten pa yi// dkar chag brtsams pa'i dga' ston brnyes la 'dud// khang gsar bsod bzang dpal bzang mkhan dbon pa// rab dkar mkhar dbon ze drung skye rab 'byams// lhun grub phun tshogs shākya grags ldan sogs// sgra snyan bzo rtsis bslab rgyun spel la 'dud// bud+dha dzñā nar 'dus pa 'phags lugs dang*// smar khrid tshom bu lugs dang gur mgon khrid// sa skyong bla mar gur mgon lha brgyad sogs// rjes gnang mang po'i gegs sel phul la 'dud// dgun gsum bcad rgya la zhugs de grol nas// bde mchog gur sam 'dus pa lugs gsum sogs// dbang dang mkha' spyod gur mgon thugs rje che'i// nyams khrid chos kyi sbyin chen stsal la 'dud// skyor mda' bsod nams pa la rta mgrin dpal// yang gsang dbang phul spyi 'dus dbang bskur zhus// mchod rten steng khang 'khri shing lha bkod dang*// zhal byang rab gnas dang bcas bskrun la 'dud// chos sder lha khang rnying pa'i gshegs gsol dang*// gsar bskrun lto 'phye'i thig dang sa chog byas// bris 'bur kun gyi lha bkod bzo bcos dang*// rab tu gnas pa'i dpal kun bskyed la 'dud// rten bzhengs dkar chag brtsams nas gzhan don gyi// bcad rgyar gnas skabs sa chen bsod nams rtse// rmi lam zhal mthong der bzhugs rdzong sdod sogs// mkha' spyod mgon po'i nyams khrid stsal la 'dud// ldan shod dpon gyi lha khang ldebs ris su// mdzad pa 'khrul med 'khri shing zhal thang yi// bkod pa'i skya ris gnyis ka'i zhal byang brtsams// rab gnas cho gas shis par bsgrubs la 'dud// rdzogs chen sprul sku gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs su// kye rdor dus chog dbang bzhi bcas par phul// ze chen pa las 'dod 'jo'i bum bzang gi

/dbang lung thob pa'i skal ba sbom la 'dud// rgya rong dbon dang mchog sprul rnam gnyis gtsos// 'dus tshogs kun la grub thob tshe dbang phul// a li chos rje sngon rjes dbang bskur sogs// dbu ma lugs kyi sems bskyed stsal la 'dud// dpal spungs sku dbon snga phyir zhing gshegs pa'i// dgongs rdzogs bsreg blugs sogs kyi mchod 'bul zhus// slar yang gsung rab par gyi 'dri zhus dang*// dbang lung chos kyis 'gro don gzhol la 'dud// par khang gan 'ji ra sogs gzungs 'bul dang*// rab gnas byas nas rang gi brtsams chos skor// glegs bam bcu gcig par gyi 'dri zhus tshugs// dpal chos zhabs brtan cho ga bsgrubs la 'dud// bkra shis ltem du dpon sras dbang bskur phul// dpal chos zhing khams gshegs pa'i gsal 'debs dang*// sku gdung ril po'i mchod rten gzungs sgrub bcas// byams chen sku brnyan rtogs brjod bskrun la 'dud// rmad shod gnyer chen bu rgyal 'bod par phyin// gshin gson cho ga'i rim pa ci yang bsgrubs// sde dge sras lcam bcas pa'i gegs sel dbang*// snga phyir bka' stsal ji bzhin brtson la 'dud// rin chen mchog grub kyis mtshon bla ma 'gar// snar thang brgya rtsa brtsams chos skor gyi lung*// rgya rong grwa pa 'ga' la rab byung dang*// 'jigs byed dbang sogs re ba bskangs la 'dud// yid lhung phyin nas mi dbon 'das bzhugs kyi// dgongs rdzogs zhabs brtan la sogs gang dgos bsgrubs// ka thog sprul sku mjal 'phrad 'phags pa yi// gsung rab le tshan lung bcas phul la 'dud// gad thog gnyer chen bsod nams ru bar phyin// ming sring 'khor bcas dbang chos re ba bskangs// skabs shig tshe dpag med sku zhal mjal yang*// dug can zas kyi rmi lam rtsub la 'dud// mkhan chen klu sdings 'dren mchog mi bdag gi /spyan drangs khri 'bul stob pa'i shis brjod dang*// maṇ+ḍal bshad pa'i srol btod sku gdung gi

/rab gnas don 'grel ngo mtshar bstan la 'dud// lcags ra sprul sku dpon slob brda sprod dang*// sdeb sbyor snyan dngags dbang bskur zhabs 'degs zhus// ldan gling kun du dbang bskur zab khrid dang*// rang gzhan bka' 'bum lung mang stsal la 'dud// lab blar zhal bzhi'i bka' gtad gsang khrid stsal// rtsis rigs sgro 'dogs chod pa'i spro dga' byung*// sa dkar 'dus sdes kho bor ring 'tshor bskul// slar yang par gyi las byed sdud la 'dud// shar chen rje las dgyes rdor rgyu dbang lam// 'jigs byed kun rig dbang dang rnam rgyal sogs// rjes gnang skor mang skyes rabs mdzad chen dang*// chos chung bka' brtsams skor mang thos la 'dud// mgon der saṃ ṭa 'chi 'joms bcu gcig zhal// 'khros nag dbang dang tshe dbang snar thang gi /brgya rtsa la sogs rjes gnang skor 'ga' yis// zhabs pad brtan pa'i cho ga bsgrubs la 'dud// thang stong rgyal po dril dkar chibs las bab// bdag la hur gzigs bar chad yod 'dra gsung*// gsang chab dkar yol gang stsal bdag dga' bas// 'di 'thung gegs las grol snyam shar la 'dud// dus mi ring bar sde dge'i sras lcam dang*// kho bo'i gcen bcas 'jig rten pha rol song*// mthong byed bsgribs dang nad gzhi'i mnar yang bdag /bder 'tsho grub chen de drin shes la 'dud// lha lcam 'chi dus bab pa ma bzlog kyang*// dku la chags pa'i sras lcam bde bar btsas// bstan srung 'phrin bcol la sogs zhabs brtan gyis// srung rim ngo mtshar grub pa de la 'dud// rang gnas khang par bka' dang dgongs 'grel chos// bka' 'bum skor bcas po ti phyed bzhi brgya// bzhugs gsol mchod pa'i yo byad rnam mang bkram// mar me rgyun 'bar mchod pas mdzes la 'dud// tshe bh+rūm̐ gnas su slob dpon 'chi med pa'i// gser sku bzhugs khang dkar chag brtsams phud dang*// rdor dril ting bdun mar me'i kong bu bcas// bstod pa tshogs 'don rgyun chags 'dzugs la 'dud// lha rgyal srang gi rten gsum rab gnas dang*// dkar chag bca' yig byas nas rol mo dang*// mkhar rnga gos 'phan dpyangs nas 'dus tshogs su// bsnyen bkur gral 'gyed tshogs bsags bgyid la 'dud// bla dge 'dus par 'jigs byed kun rig dbang*// spyi sger don gnyer ci 'dod chos sbyin stsal// nyi grags sprul sku gshegs rdzong cho ga dang*// yang sprul myur 'byon smon lam btab la 'dud// chos grwa 'dir 'khod phyogs gzhan nas lhags pa'i// don gnyer dbang khrid lung dang rjes gnang sogs// so sor rtsa ba'i rnam grangs yi ge'i lam// 'dri bar ma ldang byas byung mdo tsam mo// rang gi dbon dger sgra snyan sdeb sbyor sogs// bslab nas dbus gtsang bteg chas bla ma lha'i// 'bul yig 'dod gsol nyer bsdogs kun bsgrigs nas// rang nyid chab tshan lhan cig bteg la 'dud// rdzong dgon ser sbrengs bsu bas 'bod par phyin// dgon sde kun la chos sbyin ci yang stsal// rma rong tsha khar dbon la dur bdag gi

/bsrung dbang bgyis nas bod phyogs rdzongs la 'dud// rang gnas phyin nas sangs rgyas thod pa yi// sgrub dkyil bsgrigs nas shar chen sa phur gyi// chos rje rnam gnyis dpal spungs kun khyab sogs// dbang bskur du mas skal bzang byas la 'dud// zhwa nag mchog sprul khams phebs de skabs shig /skya mi bod chas can zhig mdun thad der// dpal spungs nye mang rā dza'i gdung dkon zhes// mi dga' rnam 'gyur byed pa mthong la 'dud// sa skyong bsnyung ba'i sku rim gting bskul skabs// sku tshe cung zad bsrings ces thos pa dang*// sde dge'i rigs sras bsnyung skabs tsan+dan sku// rang gzhan phyi bdar mtha' gtsang byed la 'dud// rang gi rtogs brjod thang kar rab gnas dang*// sde dge'i bang mdzod rnam sras dur khrod bsgrubs// rgyal rong dpon gshegs dgongs rdzogs bsgrub par phyin// mchog sprul gnyis la rgyu dbang phul la 'dud// dpon dge dpon slob dbus 'gros 'khor ba dang*// 'khor lo mdor 'phrad chabs cig dgon 'dir bteg /gzhi'i bsnyen khrid dang bca' bsgrigs smar khams sogs// bla dger mang por kye rdor stsal la 'dud// si tu rgya yul 'byon par dwogs tshul dang*// phebs rdzongs mjal phyag zhus nas sku gshegs tshe// 'dus sde'i dbur phyin kun rig cho ga bsgrubs// yang srid myur 'byon smon lam phul la 'dud// srib dgon gnyer dpon nan tan 'bod par phyin// 'chi bslu dbang bskur la sogs zhag bcu skor// re ba bskangs nas shar chen sku zhabs su// byabs khrus tshe dbang dgung grangs phul la 'dud// 'khon ston lung bzhin rnam rgyal bsnyen par bzhugs// mtshams gtor spus khengs grol nub rmi lam du// tshogs chen dkyil nas rang gi ming yod pa'i// brtan bzhugs smon lam rkang bzhi thos la 'dud// chu 'bam nges bzung dka' bas dal rten gtses// rmi lam snang bar da lam 'chi'o zhes// lan gsum 'bod thos 'tsho byed sman bcos dang*// shar chen spyan drangs dbang bskur nod la 'dud// sde dge mched lcam sogs drung 'byung 'gyur skor// zhal chems zhu yig phul zhing rang gi dbon// grwa 'khor kun la spyi sger zhal chems dang*// gnang sbyin bkod pa gang dgos byas la 'dud// lha lcam rnam gnyis mjal phyag smon lam btab// lhun grub steng gi 'dus sde yul mi kun// byin rlabs bgyis nas spyi sger dad can 'gar// gang 'tsham bslab bya'i rim pa gdams la 'dud// gnas brtan rtogs brjod lung dang 'phrin bcol stsal// me tog char dang 'ja' 'od mang du 'khrigs// sangs rgyas 'phel gdung la sogs byin rten rigs// gsol zhing rang gzhan smon lam btab la 'dud// de nas dgongs mtshams dges nyams du ma dang*// gzims chung steng na 'ja' 'od gur khang sogs// rdo rje 'chang gi phyag rgya bzhugs stangs bcas// rgyal ba'i zla

7 tshes 15 tho rengs gshegs la 'dud// dgung gsum mnyam bzhag grol 'phral sa chen g.yos// mkhan chen mchog nas gdung khrus na bza' gsol// skal ldan gdul bya mang por mjal kha btang*// phyag dang mchod 'bul smon lam brjod la 'dud// shar chen mchog gi dus tha'i cho ga yis// sku gdung zhugs phul dge slong bcu phrag gis// zhe dgu'i dgung la kye rdor sgrub mchod dang*// tshogs chen sgrub mchod nyin grangs tshugs la 'dud// gzhan phyogs kun la ma khyab med snyam gyi// dgongs rdzogs sgrub dang sāts+tsha cho ga bcas// grub nas rdo kho khang brtsegs bskrun pa dang*// rab gnas dang bcas las mthar phyin la 'dud// dri gtsang khang du lha mi'i mchod skor rten// dpal ldan sa skya'i byin sna khyad 'phags sogs// nang bzhugs du mas phyug pa'i mchod rten che// bkra shis sgo mangs rab gnas bcas grub 'dud// 'dir smras pa/ de skad mthong ba'i chos kyi gnang tshul rnams// 'phrin du shod pa mnyan 'dod slob ma'i ngor// rags bsdus smras don gzugs brnyan rnam bkod pa// brda don gsal ba'i kha byang bcas pa 'di// bskrun pa'i dge bas byang chub snying po'i bar// dal 'byor rten ldan dpal ldan bla ma dang*// 'bral med lhun grub mnyam 'grogs shes bya'i gzhung*// bcu phrag rtogs pa'i yon tan phun tshogs shog /dge legs spyod pa'i grogs dang dkon mchog gsum// skyabs mgon bzung ba sbyin pa'i bdag de yang*// bla ma rgyal ba sras bcas gsang gsum gyi// yon tan rgyud la skye ba nyid gyur cig /de sogs 'brel thogs rigs bzang dpal 'byor rgyas// blo gros rnam gsal thams cad mkhyen pa'i rgyu// shes bya kun la bslab sbyangs mthar phyin nas// rgyal bstan sems can sman 'dogs bsgrub par shog /bla ma yi dam rgyal ba sras bcas su// bsams nas mchod bstod gsol ba gang btab pa// 'grub 'gyur nges pa rgyal gsung tshad ma yi// bden pa gang gis smras don kun 'grub shog

/ces rang gi rtogs brjod thang kar bkod pa'i zhal byang don bsdu kun dga' bskyed pa'i zhing khams rgya mtsho zhes bya ba 'di'ang slob bu lhun grub phun tshogs kyi ngor/ ngag dbang tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa/ zhing gshegs rjes kyi kha 'gengs cung zad byed po gong gi rigs dbon ngag dbang dge legs lhun grub can gyis bgyis pa dge legs 'phel// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
